# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy covers the Vaneza website and, once published, its contracts and client code.

At present no contract is deployed or announced. Reports about the website, its configuration and its documentation are welcome now.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Send a private report through GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" option on this repository's Security tab. Include:

- what you found and where
- steps to reproduce
- the impact you believe it has

If that option is unavailable, contact the team through the channels listed on [vaneza.dev](https://vaneza.dev) once they are published.

## What to expect

- Acknowledgement of your report
- A good-faith assessment and updates as work proceeds
- Credit when the fix ships, if you want it

## Please

- Give us reasonable time to fix before disclosing
- Avoid accessing data that is not yours
- Do not degrade service for others

## Out of scope

- Reports that rely on social engineering of contributors
- Missing best-practice headers with no demonstrated impact
- Findings in third-party services the site reads from

## Verifying official information

The contract address and accounts become official only when the website ledger shows them as stated. Treat any other source as unverified.
